comparator.route: Management in the Digital Age specialisation with its associated thesis
comparator.sourceNotes: The official 2026–27 curriculum accounts for exactly 180 EC. Years 1 and 2 each comprise ten 6-EC components spanning strategy, economics, organisational behaviour, research methods, quantitative and qualitative analysis, operations, accounting, marketing, finance, information and data management, international business, law, ethics and entrepreneurship. The second-year restricted choice is instantiated as Innovation Management because it coheres with the formally selected third-year Management in the Digital Age specialisation; this is a route-coherence choice rather than a UCR-fit choice. Year 3 preserves 30 EC of genuine minor, study-abroad, internship or elective space, followed by an official 30-EC specialisation-and-thesis block. The public curriculum does not provide a reliable credit split inside that combined block, so no thesis credit is invented.

comparatorRouteSelection.route: Management in the Digital Age specialisation with its associated thesis
comparatorRouteSelection.basis: Among the four formal third-year specialisations, Management in the Digital Age most broadly continues the programme-wide identity in strategy, organisation, people, information, data and digital transformation. Accounting and Control, Finance, and Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Creativity are narrower functional routes. The route is selected before comparing UCR courses.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest route covers the broad business-administration core. Direct target evidence then supports a responsible and sustainable-business programme and a finance/accounting/control programme. All three are feasible 24-course curricula and satisfy the pairwise four-course distinction rule. Digital innovation and entrepreneurship are separately supported, but production stops at the maximum of three.

notes.text: UvA Business Administration requires a broad two-year sequence across business functions and methods, then 30 EC of open choice and a formal 30-EC specialisation-and-thesis block. UCR can assemble broad-management, responsible-business and finance/analytics programmes, but it does not reproduce UvA's combined specialisation-and-thesis structure or every dedicated accounting, operations and international-business component.
